title: Ginkgo
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original wide 16:9 background artwork for a minimalist personal website.
Primary request: A few graceful ginkgo leaves on slender branches framing the outer lower corners. Calm, sophisticated botanical minimalism.
Scene/backdrop: nearly flat pale sage and celadon, very quiet central and upper field.
Subject: fan-shaped ginkgo leaves with delicate radiating veins, sparse asymmetric branches entering from lower left and lower right. Keep botanical detail close to the outer edges and lower third.
Style/medium: refined printed illustration with fine ASCII-like character halftone integrated into leaf veins, leaf silhouettes, and delicate shading. Tiny imperfect typewriter glyphs form tonal texture, not readable words. Subtle printed paper grain. Soft cream highlights on dusty teal foliage evoke a tactile, slightly nostalgic digital botanical print.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:9. At least 65 percent of the image, especially central and upper space, remains nearly flat pale sage negative space for website text. Leaves never cross the central upper two-thirds. No continuous decorative border; branches remain light, sparse and asymmetrical.
Color palette: muted pale sage, celadon, warm cream/buttercream light, dusty teal; low saturation and restrained contrast.
Lighting/mood: soft diffuse light; peaceful, airy, thoughtful.
Constraints: Original art. No clouds. No text, typography, logos, UI, watermark, frame, people, pots, architecture, or bright colors. Fine halftone should feel integrated into foliage, with much lighter texture in the empty background. High detail only near outer edges and lower third.
